name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport catering was somewhat accidental, beginning with a small family-owned restaurant near the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. Initially focused on traditional Mexican cuisine, Sofia quickly adapted to the demands of feeding racing teams and VIP guests, realizing the importance of fresh, fast, and high-quality meals. Her experience managing the family business gave her the organizational skills and understanding of logistics necessary to thrive in the demanding environment of a racing team.

Sofia joined Crown Racing three years ago, and has quickly become indispensable. She prides herself on sourcing local ingredients whenever possible, ensuring that the team has access to nutritious and energizing food, even on tight deadlines and in remote locations. She believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and her dedication to quality and efficiency has earned her the respect of drivers and mechanics alike. Her knack for creating customized meal plans based on individual dietary needs and performance goals is what sets her apart.

Beyond the kitchen, Sofia is known for her meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. She is always willing to go the extra mile, whether it's tracking down a specific ingredient or adjusting the menu at the last minute to accommodate unexpected guest arrivals. Her loyalty to Crown Racing is unwavering, and she is a key part of the team's support structure.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun.
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a warm, friendly smile and a practical, no-nonsense air about her.

quirks: Always has a stash of spicy tamarind candies hidden in her catering van.
Insists on playing upbeat salsa music while prepping food, even at 5 AM.
Keeps a detailed notebook of every team member's food preferences and allergies, updated religiously.
